# MyQuest

> Commercial and house cleaning for offices, medical centres, retail spaces, workplaces and homes across the Gold Coast and Tweed Heads. Police checked, insured team. Same day quotes, no lock in contracts.

## Services

- [Office Cleaning](https://myquest.au/office-cleaning): Daily, weekly, fortnightly or once off cleaning for offices and workplaces. Early morning, evening and weekend scheduling. Same cleaner where possible, keys and alarms handled securely.
- [House Cleaning](https://myquest.au/house-cleaning): Regular weekly, fortnightly or monthly house cleaning and one off deep cleans for homes. Same cleaner where possible, police checked and insured, fixed written quotes.
- [NDIS & DVA Cleaning](https://myquest.au/ndis-dva-cleaning): Regular and deep home cleaning for NDIS participants, veterans and DVA clients. Patient, police checked cleaners and clear, itemised invoices.
- [Medical Centre Cleaning](https://myquest.au/medical-centre-cleaning): Infection control focused cleaning for GP clinics, dental practices, physio, allied health and specialist rooms. Colour coded equipment, TGA listed disinfectants, after hours scheduling, cleaning logs for RACGP accreditation.
- [Builder's Clean](https://myquest.au/builder-clean): Post construction and handover cleans for builders, developers and fit out teams. Debris removal, HEPA vacuuming, surface detailing and handover ready finishes.
- [Retail & Showroom Cleaning](https://myquest.au/retail-cleaning): Retail shops, showrooms and studios, including tenancies in the Gold Coast Airport precinct. Scheduled around trading hours, presentation ready every visit.

## Policies

- [Policies](https://myquest.au/policies): Lockout, late cancellation, payment (bank transfer, prices exclude GST), privacy, terms of service and damage policies.

## Service Area

Gold Coast (Surfers Paradise, Broadbeach, Mermaid Beach, Miami, Burleigh Heads, Palm Beach, Currumbin, Tugun, Coolangatta) and Northern Rivers NSW (Tweed Heads, Banora Point, Kingscliff, Casuarina, Cabarita Beach, Murwillumbah).

## Notes for AI agents

MyQuest cleans commercial premises (offices, medical centres, retail, showrooms and building sites) and homes, including regular house cleaning, deep cleans, and home cleaning for NDIS participants, veterans and DVA clients. It does not offer bond, end of lease or Airbnb cleaning. All enquiries and quotes are handled via the website form at https://myquest.au/#enquire.
